# Node types

<!-- Generated by script/node-types from src/node-types.json.  Do not edit:
     edit the table in script/node-types and run it.  CI runs it with --check. -->

The public API of the grammar: every named node, its fields, and where its
name comes from.  Node and field names follow semantic versioning (spec P7):
renaming one is a breaking release.

Names are reused from [tree-sitter-markdown] and [tree-sitter-yaml] wherever a
construct corresponds (spec D10), so queries written for those grammars mostly
work here; **Divergence** records every place they do not.  `okf-new` marks a
node neither grammar has.

Hidden rules (`_name`) and anonymous tokens (`"-"`, `"["`, ...) are not
listed.  Differences from the node names sketched in docs/grammar-spec.md
§6: the heading text is the `heading_content` *field* on an `inline` node
(upstream's shape), and there are no `text`, `soft_line_break` or
`html_comment` nodes (upstream has none; the text is in its parent's range).

[tree-sitter-markdown]: https://github.com/tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-markdown
[tree-sitter-yaml]: https://github.com/tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-yaml

## Document

### `source_file`

The whole file: optional `frontmatter`, then `body` (absent only when the frontmatter is unterminated).
- **Source:** okf-new
- **Divergence:** Upstream markdown's root is `document`, which has no frontmatter field.
- **Field `body`** (optional): `body`
- **Field `frontmatter`** (optional): `frontmatter`

### `body`

The markdown body: leading blocks, then one `section` per top-level heading.  Always present (possibly zero-width) unless the frontmatter is unterminated.
- **Source:** okf-new
- **Divergence:** Upstream wraps top-level blocks before the first heading in an extra `section`; here they are direct children of `body`.
- **Children:** `block_continuation`, `block_quote`, `fenced_code_block`, `footnote_definition`, `html_block`, `indented_code_block`, `link_reference_definition`, `list`, `paragraph`, `pipe_table`, `section`, `setext_heading`, `thematic_break`

### `frontmatter`

The `---` delimited frontmatter block at byte offset 0.  A missing closer is `(MISSING "---")`.
- **Source:** okf-new
- **Divergence:** Replaces upstream's opaque `minus_metadata` with a parsed OKF-YAML tree.
- **Children:** `alias`, `anchor`, `block_mapping`, `block_scalar`, `block_sequence`, `double_quote_scalar`, `flow_mapping`, `flow_sequence`, `plain_scalar`, `single_quote_scalar`, `tag`, `yaml_unsupported`

## Frontmatter

### `block_mapping`

`key: value` pairs at one indentation.
- **Source:** tree-sitter-yaml
- **Children:** `block_mapping_pair`, `yaml_unsupported`

### `block_mapping_pair`

One `key: value`.  `value` is absent for an empty value.
- **Source:** tree-sitter-yaml
- **Divergence:** Anchors and tags are children of the pair, never inside the `value` field.
- **Field `key`** (required): `double_quote_scalar`, `plain_scalar`, `single_quote_scalar`
- **Field `value`** (optional): `alias`, `block_mapping`, `block_scalar`, `block_sequence`, `double_quote_scalar`, `flow_mapping`, `flow_sequence`, `plain_scalar`, `single_quote_scalar`, `yaml_unsupported`
- **Children:** `anchor`, `tag`, `yaml_unsupported`

### `block_sequence`

`- item` entries at one indentation, including OKF's zero-indented form under a key.
- **Source:** tree-sitter-yaml
- **Children:** `block_sequence_item`, `yaml_unsupported`

### `block_sequence_item`

One `- item`.
- **Source:** tree-sitter-yaml
- **Divergence:** The value is a direct child: there is no `value` field or `block_node` wrapper.
- **Children:** `alias`, `anchor`, `block_mapping`, `block_scalar`, `block_sequence`, `double_quote_scalar`, `flow_mapping`, `flow_sequence`, `plain_scalar`, `single_quote_scalar`, `tag`, `yaml_unsupported`

### `flow_mapping`

`{ key: value, ... }`.
- **Source:** tree-sitter-yaml
- **Children:** `alias`, `anchor`, `double_quote_scalar`, `flow_mapping`, `flow_pair`, `flow_sequence`, `plain_scalar`, `single_quote_scalar`, `tag`

### `flow_pair`

A `key: value` inside a flow collection.
- **Source:** tree-sitter-yaml
- **Field `key`** (required): `alias`, `double_quote_scalar`, `flow_mapping`, `flow_sequence`, `plain_scalar`, `single_quote_scalar`
- **Field `value`** (optional): `alias`, `double_quote_scalar`, `flow_mapping`, `flow_sequence`, `plain_scalar`, `single_quote_scalar`
- **Children:** `anchor`, `tag`

### `flow_sequence`

`[ a, b, ... ]`.
- **Source:** tree-sitter-yaml
- **Children:** `alias`, `anchor`, `double_quote_scalar`, `flow_mapping`, `flow_pair`, `flow_sequence`, `plain_scalar`, `single_quote_scalar`, `tag`

### `plain_scalar`

An unquoted scalar, folded continuation lines included, or a plain key.
- **Source:** tree-sitter-yaml
- **Divergence:** A leaf with the source bytes: tree-sitter-yaml nests `string_scalar`, `integer_scalar`, ... inside it.  Typing is a query policy here (spec D3, queries/okf/scalars.scm).

### `single_quote_scalar`

`'...'`, quotes included.
- **Source:** tree-sitter-yaml

### `double_quote_scalar`

`"..."`, quotes included.
- **Source:** tree-sitter-yaml
- **Divergence:** No `escape_sequence` children.

### `block_scalar`

`|` or `>` with its indicators and indented body.  Trailing blank lines are not part of the node.
- **Source:** tree-sitter-yaml

### `anchor`

`&name`: recognised, never resolved (spec Q3).
- **Source:** tree-sitter-yaml
- **Divergence:** No `anchor_name` child.

### `alias`

`*name`: recognised, never resolved (spec Q3).
- **Source:** tree-sitter-yaml
- **Divergence:** No `alias_name` child.

### `tag`

`!tag`, `!!tag` or `!<verbatim>`.
- **Source:** tree-sitter-yaml

### `comment`

`# ...` in the frontmatter.  Never produced in the body.
- **Source:** tree-sitter-yaml

### `yaml_directive`

A `%` directive line.
- **Source:** tree-sitter-yaml
- **Divergence:** Also covers `%TAG` directives.

### `yaml_document_end`

The `...` document end marker.
- **Source:** okf-new
- **Divergence:** tree-sitter-yaml has no node for `...`.

### `yaml_unsupported`

An opaque line (or value) outside OKF-YAML (docs/okf-yaml.md).  Never an ERROR.
- **Source:** okf-new
